title: ToolsPanel renders tools as a single column instead of the Flash 8 two-column grid
description:
USER-REPORTED layout bug.

REPRO: Open the Tools panel. The tool buttons stack in one vertical column (Selection, Subselection, Free Transform, ... all top-to-bottom in a single file), instead of Flash 8's two-column grid.

ROOT CAUSE: packages/authoring-ui/src/ToolsPanel.tsx:303 — the `toolGrid` style sets `gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(1, ${BTN_SIZE}px)`` (a SINGLE column). The data structure TOOL_ROWS (lines 222-262) is already authored as 2-wide pairs (Selection|Subselection, Free Transform|Gradient Transform, ...) and is flattened into the grid, so with only 1 grid column every button wraps onto its own row -> one vertical column. The line-220 comment even says 'Flash 8 tool grid — 2 columns, top to bottom'.

EXPECTED (docs/30-flash8-ui-spec.md): a 2-column grid. Spec metrics (§ Metrics, lines 158-159) give tools-panel-width ~67px and tool-cell ~22px — 67px fits two 22px cells (44px + gap + padding) but is far too wide for a single 22px column, corroborating 2 columns. Order is left-to-right then down per the authored pairs: Selection (top-left) / Subselection (top-right); Free Transform / Gradient Transform; Lasso / Pen; Line / Text; Oval / Rectangle; PolyStar / Pencil; Brush / Ink Bottle; Paint Bucket / Eyedropper; Eraser / Hand; Zoom (single, last). NOTE the authored TOOL_ROWS order swaps a few pairs vs the canonical real-Flash-8 order (e.g. Free Transform|Gradient Transform are reversed, Oval|Rect reversed); the pairing is already grid-correct so a straight 2-col render maps fine, but reviewer may optionally align ordering to the spec/real-Flash order.

ACTUAL: single vertical column.

REGRESSION (not long-standing): introduced by f27bb24 ('Flash 8 re-theme Wave B: top chrome (MenuBar + EditBar + ToolsPanel) -> light Halo'). That commit changed toolGrid from `gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(2, 1fr)'` + `width: '100%'` (original at 4b4e4cf 'initial progress', which was 2-column) to `repeat(1, ${BTN_SIZE}px)` + `justifyContent: 'center'`. So it was 2-column from inception and the re-theme broke it.

FIX DIRECTION: in ToolsPanel.tsx `toolGrid` style, restore a 2-column grid — `gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(2, ${BTN_SIZE}px)`` (keep the rest of the re-theme: gap 1px, justify-content center, padding) so the existing flattened TOOL_ROWS pairs render left-to-right then down. The panel width (~67px) already accommodates two 22px cells. Verify the trailing single 'Zoom' tool sits correctly in the bottom-left and the color section/dividers still align.

DISTINCT FROM task 1262 (ToolsPanel button up/active state + hover styling): same component, different concern — 1262 is per-button visual state/hover; THIS is the grid column-count/layout.

Investigated at HEAD 39acc85522890563f5e45c011cd04d119883e776 (code-path only; no Playwright/Ruffle run).
